subject.title: Gateway memory growth due to repeated file read errors

question: Should this be fixed by changing the scheduled producer that asks for CORE.md and agent-tasks, or by changing the generic read tool contract for directory and optional memory reads?
rationale: Source proof shows partial fixes and a remaining directory-read failure shape, but the correct owner boundary depends on whether the repeated reads are bad scheduled prompts or intentionally tolerated read-tool inputs.

options.title: Reproduce and fix the producer
options.body: Run a current-release scheduler/gateway repro with stability diagnostics, then correct the prompt or cron/heartbeat producer that asks for stale paths.

options.title: Broaden read-tool semantics
options.body: Accept that read may return directory listings or optional context for more path classes, with tests documenting the new model-facing contract.

options.title: Split residuals
options.body: Track CORE.md producer discovery, directory-read semantics, and RSS retention as separate issues if live repro shows different root causes.

recommendation.title: Reproduce and fix the producer
recommendation.body: Run a current-release scheduler/gateway repro with stability diagnostics, then correct the prompt or cron/heartbeat producer that asks for stale paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses the session read-tool and scheduled heartbeat/gateway boundary where recent history points to this routing candidate.
